meta.description: Combination stage of the houndframe trial (?hound=2, the frozen CP2 baseline). Same route and terrain jump as hound-grounded.json, with the dodge jump at 1230ms - measured SAFE against the lone houndframe and punished every run once a wasp cruises the arc over its plate, by the dive rather than the charge (frame-accurate attribution: wasp/dive at y~4.8, airborne). That narrowing is the combination: DESIGN's 'hound forces the jump that the wasp contests', measured rather than asserted. A perfectly timed dodge (1280-1330ms) still clears both, so the squeeze is a window mastery can thread, not a wall.

servedFixture.source: window.HB.fixture + HB.snapshot() on the served page

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: fixture retries: sliceStats.attempts increments (src/main.js resetGame, inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)`). A HULL FALLBACK absorption is not a retry — see metrics.score.setbacks — and a manual R restart increments the same counter.

lives.unavailableReason: this trace carries neither player.lives (the ?testapi/HB telemetry field, added T-025) nor a HUD ×N readout (the traversal slice does not print one, src/ui/hud.js) — no life count can be recovered from it

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against the SERVED build's own fixture (window.HB.fixture, id "traversal-v1"), radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
